published._comment: Manufacturer specification. These are measurements and must not be tuned. Anything derived from them belongs in CanopyGeometry, not here.

assumed._comment: Not published. Each is an assumption with a stated reason, to be replaced when the rib plan and pattern are digitised.

arcExponent.why: Distribution of arc curvature toward the tips. Only the span ratio is published, which fixes how much span the arc consumes; how that curvature is spread is not. 1.0 is a circular arc giving 64.7 deg at the tip and 2.94 m of arc; 1.9 gives 83.2 deg and 2.49 m. 1.3 sits between with a plausible tip angle.

billowFraction.why: Peak chord-cut seam allowance, tapering to zero at the leading and trailing edges. Sets the inflated section through the membrane relaxation rather than being drawn.

internalPressurePa.why: Cell pressure above ambient, taken as trim dynamic pressure. Level 5 of the master plan solves it from inlet flow instead.

membraneStiffnessNPerM.why: Coated ripstop membrane stiffness, Young's modulus times thickness. Order-of-magnitude from the cloth literature; drives how far the fabric stretches under hoop tension.

derived._comment: Computed by CanopyGeometry from the published figures, recorded here so a change shows up in review. Flat span, flat area and projected span are exact by construction; the rest are checks.

safety: Simulator content. Handling and polar are unvalidated; see the coefficient registry.
